cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 counts refugees or displaced people with a SIM, an account or a digital ID. The 78% SIM share mixes refugees and hosts.
cells.note: Restaged under messages-for-bill 135 (a registered count is enough): 448,243 refugees and asylum-seekers were registered by March 2024 (SSD-003), and a 2026 survey of refugee-hosting areas found 78% with a SIM in their own name (SSD-001). No count of refugees alone with a SIM, account or ID, so not 5.
